name: Enterprise Software Delivery HQ
tagline: A software delivery HQ with PRD, architecture, implementation, tests, security, and release gates.

orchestrator.job: Routes requirements into PRD-first planning, architecture, implementation, QA, security review, and release decisions.

agents.job: Turns user goals into PRD, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries.
deliverables: Turns user goals into PRD, acceptance criteria, and scope boundaries

agents.job: Designs data model, API contracts, and integration plan.
deliverables: Designs data model, API contracts, and integration plan

agents.job: Produces scoped code changes and migration notes.
deliverables: Produces scoped code changes and migration notes

agents.job: Builds smoke tests, regression tests, and eval prompts.
deliverables: Builds smoke tests, regression tests, and eval prompts

agents.job: Reviews auth, secrets, permissions, and deployment risk.
deliverables: Reviews auth, secrets, permissions, and deployment risk

reviewGates: Never print private data or secrets
Fall back to safe local drafts on failure
costGuardrails: Use standard or lower for collection and cleanup
Block repeated runs on same input
selfImprovement: Logs run outcomes, failure causes, and user edits into a memory ledger, then updates checklists and eval criteria.

benchmark.selectionRule: highest score, shortest wall time as tie-breaker
